mapper.select: SELECT TERMS_ID, TERMS_TYPE, VERSION, TITLE, CONTENT, REQUIRED_YN, EFFECTIVE_DT, USE_YN, REGIST_DT FROM TERMS WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' AND (EFFECTIVE_DT IS NULL OR EFFECTIVE_DT <= CURRENT_DATE) ORDER BY CASE WHEN REQUIRED_YN = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, TERMS_TYPE, VERSION
SELECT TERMS_ID, TERMS_TYPE, VERSION, TITLE, REQUIRED_YN FROM TERMS WHERE TERMS_ID = #{termsId} AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND (EFFECTIVE_DT IS NULL OR EFFECTIVE_DT <= CURRENT_DATE)

SELECT T.TERMS_ID, T.TERMS_TYPE, T.VERSION, T.TITLE, T.CONTENT, T.REQUIRED_YN, T.EFFECTIVE_DT FROM TERMS T WHERE T.USE_YN = 'Y' AND T.REQUIRED_YN = 'Y' AND (T.EFFECTIVE_DT IS NULL OR T.EFFECTIVE_DT <= CURRENT_DATE) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM USER_TERMS_CONSENT C WHERE C.USER_ID = #{userId} AND C.TERMS_ID = T.TERMS_ID AND C.CONSENT_YN = 'Y' ) ORDER BY T.TERMS_TYPE, T.VERSION

SELECT C.USER_ID, C.TERMS_ID, C.CONSENT_YN, C.CONSENT_DT, T.TERMS_TYPE, T.VERSION, T.TITLE FROM USER_TERMS_CONSENT C JOIN TERMS T ON T.TERMS_ID = C.TERMS_ID WHERE C.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY C.CONSENT_DT DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USER_TERMS_CONSENT (USER_ID, TERMS_ID, CONSENT_YN, CONSENT_DT) VALUES (#{userId}, #{termsId}, 'Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
